nextSteps: Open the Simulator app (makes it visible): xcodebuildmcp simulator-management open
Install an app: xcodebuildmcp simulator install --simulator-id D0A57941-A228-4C31-8496-487FC0863DEC --app-path PATH_TO_YOUR_APP
Launch an app: xcodebuildmcp simulator launch-app --simulator-id D0A57941-A228-4C31-8496-487FC0863DEC --bundle-id YOUR_APP_BUNDLE_ID
